description: Merit Packaging Limited is a printing and packaging company in the Lakson Group, incorporated in 1980 and quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It produces offset and flexible packaging — folding cartons, wrappers and labels, and point-of-sale material — for consumer goods, food and beverage, surgical instrument and textile customers, from a factory in Korangi, Karachi, with an additional facility in Lahore.
headOffice: Lakson Square, Building No. 2, Sarwar Shaheed Road, Karachi 74200, Pakistan
